# Map-6 — GTA HUB

> Free interactive maps and sourced guides for Grand Theft Auto VI (and classic GTA maps). Fan project — not Rockstar or Take-Two.

## Primary URLs

- Homepage: https://map-6.com/
- Interactive map: https://map-6.com/map
- GTA 5 map landing: https://map-6.com/en/maps/gta5
- Database (source-tagged): https://map-6.com/en/database
- Collectibles (sample pins only): https://map-6.com/collectibles
- Guides: https://map-6.com/guides
- Creators / overlay: https://map-6.com/en/creators
- Pro waitlist: https://map-6.com/en/pro
- Sitemap: https://map-6.com/sitemap.xml
- News: https://map-6.com/en/news
- Extended Look how to watch: https://map-6.com/en/guides/gta-6-extended-look-how-to-watch
- Extended Look times (EU): https://map-6.com/en/news/gta-6-extended-look-watch-times
- Extended Look map pause list: https://map-6.com/en/news/gta-6-extended-look-map-watch-for
- Extended Look live notes: https://map-6.com/en/news/gta-6-extended-look-live-notes

## Trust policy

- Confirmed = named on rockstargames.com/VI or Newswire.
- Trailer-visible = on-screen in official trailers; generic types, not invented in-game names.
- Community map tiles © GTADB / GTA VI Mapping Community — CC BY 4.0 (https://gtadb.org).
- No leak weapon catalogs, no fake official PC dates, no invented collectible totals.

## What Map-6 provides

- GTA 6 map plus classics: GTA 5 (`/map?game=gta5`), Vice City, San Andreas
- Unlimited local found tracker (export/import JSON)
- EU conversion guides (PC date, specs, PS5 vs Xbox, France price, FAQ)
- Creator overlay (`/overlay`) with theme and `ref=` tags
